verses.en: A Song; a Psalm of the sons of Korah.
verses.kjv: A Song [and] Psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.web: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah.

verses.he: גָּ֘דֹ֤ול יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד בְּעִ֥יר אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗ינוּ הַר־קָדְשֹֽׁו׃
verses.ar: عَظِيمٌ هُوَ ٱلرَّبُّ وَحَمِيدٌ جِدًّا فِي مَدِينَةِ إِلَهِنَا، جَبَلِ قُدْسِهِ.
verses.en: Great is the LORD, and highly to be praised, in the city of our God, His holy mountain,
verses.kjv: Great [is] the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, [in] the mountain of his holiness.
verses.web: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

verses.he: יְפֵ֥ה נֹוף֮ מְשֹׂ֪ושׂ כָּל־הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ הַר־צִ֭יֹּון יַרְכְּתֵ֣י צָפֹ֑ון קִ֝רְיַ֗ת מֶ֣לֶךְ רָֽב׃
verses.ar: جَمِيلُ ٱلِٱرْتِفَاعِ، فَرَحُ كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ، جَبَلُ صِهْيَوْنَ. فَرَحُ أَقَاصِي ٱلشِّمَالِ، مَدِينَةُ ٱلْمَلِكِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ.
verses.en: Fair in situation, the joy of the whole earth; even mount Zion, the uttermost parts of the north, the city of the great King.
verses.kjv: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, [is] mount Zion, [on] the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
verses.web: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.

verses.en: God in her palaces hath made Himself known for a stronghold.
verses.kjv: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
verses.web: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ هُوَذَا ٱلْمُلُوكُ ٱجْتَمَعُوا. مَضَوْا جَمِيعًا.
verses.en: For, lo, the kings assembled themselves, they came onward together.
verses.kjv: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
verses.web: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.

verses.he: הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ כֵּ֣ן תָּמָ֑הוּ נִבְהֲל֥וּ נֶחְפָּֽזוּ׃
verses.en: They saw, straightway they were amazed; they were affrighted, they hasted away.
verses.kjv: They saw [it, and] so they marvelled; they were troubled, [and] hasted away.
verses.web: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.

verses.en: Trembling took hold of them there, pangs, as of a woman in travail.
verses.kjv: Fear took hold upon them there, [and] pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.web: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.

verses.en: With the east wind Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish.
verses.kjv: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
verses.web: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.

verses.he: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁמַ֨עְנוּ ׀ כֵּ֤ן רָאִ֗ינוּ בְּעִיר־יְהוָ֣ה צְ֭בָאֹות בְּעִ֣יר אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֱלֹ֘הִ֤ים יְכֹונְנֶ֖הָ עַד־עֹולָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: كَمَا سَمِعْنَا هَكَذَا رَأَيْنَا فِي مَدِينَةِ رَبِّ ٱلْجُنُودِ، فِي مَدِينَةِ إِلَهِنَا. ٱللهُ يُثَبِّتُهَا إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God — God establish it for ever. Selah
verses.kjv: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.
verses.web: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of Yahweh of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.

verses.ar: ذَكَرْنَا يَا ٱللهُ رَحْمَتَكَ فِي وَسَطِ هَيْكَلِكَ.
verses.en: We have thought on Thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of Thy temple.
verses.kjv: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.
verses.web: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.

verses.he: כְּשִׁמְךָ֤ אֱלֹהִ֗ים כֵּ֣ן תְּ֭הִלָּתְךָ עַל־קַצְוֵי־אֶ֑רֶץ צֶ֝֗דֶק מָלְאָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: نَظِيرُ ٱسْمِكَ يَا ٱللهُ تَسْبِيحُكَ إِلَى أَقَاصِي ٱلْأَرْضِ. يَمِينُكَ مَلآنَةٌ بِرًّا.
verses.en: As is Thy name, O God, so is Thy praise unto the ends of the earth; Thy right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.kjv: According to thy name, O God, so [is] thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.web: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.

verses.he: יִשְׂמַ֤ח ׀ הַר־צִיֹּ֗ון תָּ֭גֵלְנָה בְּנֹ֣ות יְהוּדָ֑ה לְ֝מַ֗עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: يَفْرَحُ جَبَلُ صِهْيَوْنَ، تَبْتَهِجُ بَنَاتُ يَهُوذَا مِنْ أَجْلِ أَحْكَامِكَ.
verses.en: Let mount Zion be glad, let the daughters of Judah rejoice, because of Thy judgments.
verses.kjv: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.
verses.web: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.

verses.ar: طُوفُوا بِصِهْيَوْنَ، وَدُورُوا حَوْلَهَا. عُدُّوا أَبْرَاجَهَا.
verses.en: Walk about Zion, and go round about her; count the towers thereof.
verses.kjv: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
verses.web: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.

verses.he: שִׁ֤יתוּ לִבְּכֶ֨ם ׀ לְֽחֵילָ֗ה פַּסְּג֥וּ אַרְמְנֹותֶ֑יהָ לְמַ֥עַן תְּ֝סַפְּר֗וּ לְדֹ֣ור אַחֲרֹֽון׃
verses.ar: ضَعُوا قُلُوبَكُمْ عَلَى مَتَارِسِهَا. تَأَمَّلُوا قُصُورَهَا لِكَيْ تُحَدِّثُوا بِهَا جِيلًا آخَرَ.
verses.en: Mark ye well her ramparts, traverse her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.
verses.kjv: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell [it] to the generation following.
verses.web: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.

verses.he: כִּ֤י זֶ֨ה ׀ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֱ֭לֹהֵינוּ עֹולָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד ה֖וּא יְנַהֲגֵ֣נוּ עַל־מֽוּת׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱللهَ هَذَا هُوَ إِلَهُنَا إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ وَٱلْأَبَدِ. هُوَ يَهْدِينَا حَتَّى إِلَى ٱلْمَوْتِ.
verses.en: For such is God, our God, for ever and ever; He will guide us eternally.
verses.kjv: For this God [is] our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide [even] unto death.
verses.web: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
